artifact_observations.reasoning: While the overall structure of the text is correct (columns, alignment), the individual characters appear slightly soft and lack the crisp edges of high-resolution print. Some character shapes may be nonsensical upon close inspection, a common AI artifact, though hard to verify without OCR. It is not catastrophic (severity 4-5) but noticeable as a slight lack of sharpness/legibility.

The zebra pattern on the scarf is very high contrast. The edges of the stripes show very slight bleeding into the fabric texture, which is subtle but characteristic of generative models struggling with fine, repetitive high-frequency patterns.
